items.title: CONCEALMENT
items.quote: A song [to be accompanied on the instrument called] alamos (concealment).
items.text: While the direct influence of Hashem upon world events is hidden from us, the time will come that everything will be clear.

items.title: CATACLYSM
items.quote: G-d [will be] our shelter and strength. [His] help with troubles [will be] very quickly forthcoming.
items.text: When faced with cataclysmic events in nature, such as earthquakes and floods, you should maintain your peace of mind, for Hashem is your shelter.

items.quote: Therefore, we will not be afraid when He transforms the earth, when mountains tip over into the midst of the seas.

items.title: YERUSHALAYIM
items.quote: [There is a] river. Its streams will make the City of G-d rejoice, the holiest of the dwelling places of the Most High.
items.text: In the face of world turbulence you should be calmed by your bitachon that when the Geulah comes, a river of spiritual peace and serenity will flow from the Bais Hamikdash throughout the world.

items.quote: G-d [will be] in its midst, it will not be toppled. G-d will help it towards the dawn.
items.text: As the dawn of the Geulah approaches, even if there is destruction all around, Yerushalayim will be protected.

items.title: BITACHON
items.quote: Hashem, Master of Legions, is with us. [He is a] stronghold for us, the G-d of Yaakov, Selah.
items.text: Be confident in the permanent bond that Hashem has with the Jewish people.

items.title: WAR
items.quote: Come and reflect upon the acts of Hashem for He has made a cataclysm in the earth.
items.text: Hashem will reveal His power when He wages victorious war against those powerful nations who seek to destroy the tiny nation of Yisrael.

items.title: PEACE
items.quote: He cancels wars to the end of the earth.
items.text: Hashem will cancel war for all mankind because everyone will be united in devotion to Him.
“[Desist [from wars] and know that I am G-d. I shall be exalted among the nations. I shall be exalted upon the [entire] earth.”
